prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Identity Loss Prevention Hint: Add an explicit safety hint below sign-in options explaining that signing in permanently links your pet so it never resets across app relaunches. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or resetting after signing in, which creates severe post-onboarding churn.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Progress Checklist: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic step checklist showing actual asset rendering and desktop integration status. (why: The waiting step in home has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support reports pet rendering/display bugs.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Stage Presentation Layout: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a stage view with prominent animated choices so users instantly grasp standard vs custom pet options. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with a very long mean time of 514s due to decision hesitation.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Preparation Quality Checklist Flow: Add an interactive quality check panel to the photo upload screen to verify image lighting and clarity before submission. (why: Support logged 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or produced broken visuals.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Quickstart Screen: Insert a dedicated quickstart guidance screen right before home intro that shows how to wake, hide, and interact with the pet. (why: Users struggle with desktop pet interactions after setup (3 support tickets), causing drop-off right before completion.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Sound Notification Toggle: Enable an active system audio alert setting on the waiting screen so users get notified when their desktop pet finishes loading. (why: Waiting stage median time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to tab away and forget to complete onboarding.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Pet Account Sync Copy: Reframe sign-in headline and body copy around permanent cloud sync so users know sign-in saves their pet state permanently. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing/reset pets after re-authenticating, and sign-in drops 25.7% of users.)
